message.content:
1. Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
2. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
3. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
4. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
5. This new hobby consumed their days and nights entirely.
6. They spent hours observing how mortals mixed mortar.
7. The texture of the clay was fascinating to them.
8. It reminded them of the damp earth beneath their roots.
9. However, building a sturdy wall required more than just soil.
10. They needed stones that could withstand the rain.
11. So, they ventured deep into the nearby quarries.
12. The heavy rocks were difficult to lift without magic.
13. Their staff hummed with power when they focused.
14. Each stone floated gently into place above their heads.
15. The process was slow but incredibly rewarding for them.
16. They imagined the families who would live inside.
17. Warmth and safety were the primary goals of this craft.
18. The mortar dried quickly under the bright sun.
19. Pebble Spring felt a sense of pride growing within.
20. Their first small shelter was beginning to take shape.
21. It was not perfect, but it stood firm.
22. They added a simple door made from fallen branches.
23. A window frame allowed the light to peek in.
24. The surface of the stone felt slightly **spotty** under their careful inspection.
25. This imperfection did not bother them at all.
26. In fact, it added character to the structure.
27. They planned to build many more such homes.
28. Each one would be unique in its design.
29. The mortals were curious about their strange builder.
30. Some offered food in exchange for shelter.
31. Pebble Spring accepted these gifts with gratitude.
32. The bond between nature and civilization grew stronger.
33. Their magic became more refined over time.
34. They could now shape wood as easily as stone.
35. The city began to notice their unique architecture.
